records.title: Expansion of thermal power capacity.
details: a to c: Buxar Thermal Power Project (BTPP) location at Chausa Village in Buxar District of Bihar is being developed by SJVN Thermal Power Limited (STPL), a wholly owned subsidiary of SJVN Limited under the Ministry of Power. The Project is currently under construction and have two (02) Units of 660 MW each with total capacity of 1,320 MW.

records.title: Setting up of Universities in Bihar
details:
At present, there is a proposal under consideration of this
Ministry for establishment of a new Central University near Bhagalpur at the historic site of Vikramshila University as announced in PM Package for Bihar in 2015.
